purpose: Close the source-completion gap left by the relaxed v7.6 NEQ triangle. Give an explicit four-C4 open Hamiltonian gadget whose two hidden C4 components are fully saturated, whose two named terminal C4 components each expose exactly two dangling Hamiltonian half-edges, and whose exact terminal orbit projection is NEQ_3. The stronger full boundary statement is rigid: for every unequal terminal orbit pair there is exactly one allowed relative S3 gain. The gadget is obtained by deleting two X-Y edges from one genuine Hamiltonian 16-cycle, so its remaining H-subgraph is exactly two paths and can be spliced into a larger Hamiltonian construction without any hidden H-cycle. All later composition must retain the rigid gain table; the orbit-only NEQ projection is not declared gauge-transparent.

components.each_component: A complementary C4 with ports 0,1,2,3 and canonical orbit representatives T0=(0,1,0,1), T1=(0,1,0,2), T2=(0,1,2,1).

topology.hidden_saturation: Every Z and W port has H-degree exactly two inside the gadget.
topology.component_type: Two vertex-disjoint eight-vertex paths; there is no internal H-cycle.
topology.completion_witness: Reinsert the two cut edges Y1-X1 and Y2-X0 and the two paths splice into exactly the displayed simple Hamiltonian 16-cycle.

exact_boundary_semantics.global_symmetry_fix: Fix g_X=id. For each terminal orbit pair (tau_X,tau_Y), existentially quantify tau_Z,tau_W and gauges g_Z,g_W,g_Y subject to all fourteen kept Hamiltonian inequalities.
exact_boundary_semantics.rigidity: For every unequal orbit pair exactly one relative terminal S3 gain is allowed. Equal orbit pairs have no extension. Hence the full terminal relation is an orbit-rigid six-pair gain relation whose orbit projection is NEQ_3.

main_theorem.name: FOUR_C4_SOURCE_OPEN_RIGID_NEQ_GAIN_WIRE
main_theorem.statement: There exists an explicit four-component smooth-C4 open Hamiltonian gadget with two saturated hidden components Z,W and exactly two dangling H half-edges on each terminal X,Y such that its terminal orbit relation is NEQ_3 and each accepted unequal orbit pair forces a unique relative S3 gain.
proof: Start from the displayed Hamiltonian 16-cycle and delete exactly the two displayed X-Y edges. Direct degree replay gives hidden degree vector [2,2,2,2] on both Z and W and terminal degree vectors [1,1,2,2] on X and [2,1,1,2] on Y.
Deleting two edges of one cycle produces the two displayed paths, so the open gadget contains no closed H-component and has an explicit Hamiltonian splicing completion witness.

Fix g_X=id and exhaust all three choices each of tau_Z,tau_W, all six gauges each of g_Z,g_W,g_Y, for every one of the nine terminal orbit pairs. Equal pairs have zero extensions; every unequal pair has extensions.
Refining by g_Y shows that every unequal pair accepts exactly one g_Y, equivalently one relative h_XY=g_Y^{-1}g_X. The listed table records those unique gains.

positive: Closes the topological completion gap of v7.6: a source-open cyclic NEQ primitive exists with all hidden C4 ports saturated and controlled terminal dangling ports.
The primitive is stronger than an orbit mask: its exact six-pair gain table can be composed using the v7.2 holonomy machinery without inventing hidden gauge choices.
The two-path topology gives an explicit Hamiltonian splicing interface rather than merely a port-capacity certificate.
firewall: Do not replace this gadget by a pure NEQ_3 constraint when composing multiple gadgets. It is not gauge-transparent; each unequal orbit pair forces a specific relative S3 gain.

External Hamiltonian edges attach to the four dangling terminal vertices and can impose additional colour constraints. Exact composition must retain terminal orbit labels, terminal gauges/relative gains, and the concrete dangling-port identities.
This gadget alone does not prove NP-hardness of the resulting rigid-gain language and does not yield a polynomial solver.

minimality_scope.statement: v7.5 excludes every acyclic intercomponent-bundle gadget from realizing orbit EQ_3/NEQ_3. v7.6 exhaustively excludes a three-C4 reusable binary cycle with its sole hidden component saturated and at least two dangling terminal half-edges on each terminal. Therefore four C4 components are the first achieved size for this exact source-open interface within the intercomponent-bundle language tested here.
minimality_scope.caveat: This is not an absolute graph-theoretic minimality claim because same-C4 Hamiltonian diagonal edges and interface definitions outside the enumerated intercomponent-bundle language were not included in the three-component negative gate.

Determine the finite relational closure actually realizable by Hamiltonian splicing. First ask whether two or three v7.7 wires can realize a gauge-transparent EQ_3/NEQ_3 terminal relation or a known hard three-state relation without saturating external terminals. Every composition must be checked as an actual set of paths that can be spliced into one Hamiltonian cycle; orbit-mask pp intersections are forbidden unless accompanied by an explicit port/gain construction.
